beneficiary_or_project: National remote-sensing satellite constellation and downstream services
status_or_evidence_as_of: ESA assigned EUR 797m; 8 upstream contracts signed + 8 awarded; 1 work order for large satellite launch; 5 downstream contracts + 4 service contracts
amount_type: PNRR subinvestment allocation
R&D_relevance: Mixed, relatively high upstream design/development; downstream services and launches not necessarily R&D
additionality_and_accounting_note: MIMIT report excludes additional PNC amounts EUR 273m ESA, EUR 40m ASI and EUR 90m CDP Space Venture from this PNRR figure. Separate R&D design/development from launches, procurement and routine services.
source_reference: MIMIT PNRR report, p.52

beneficiary_or_project: Space Factory 4.0; Space Transportation System; High Trust Engine
status_or_evidence_as_of: EUR 60m assigned to ASI for Space Factory 4.0; EUR 120m assigned to ESA for Access to Space R&D and prototyping; 3 Space Factory contracts worth EUR 57.282m incl. VAT
amount_type: PNRR subinvestment allocation
R&D_relevance: High for Access to Space R&D/prototyping; mixed for factory construction/equipment
additionality_and_accounting_note: Explicit R&D, development and prototyping for green propulsion/launch technologies and flight demonstration. Factory construction, production line equipment and standard manufacturing assets should not automatically be counted as R&D.
source_reference: MIMIT PNRR report, p.53

status_or_evidence_as_of: MIMIT report identifies four projects; 3 completed/ongoing project records in table at June 2025; design work in progress
amount_type: PNRR subinvestment allocation

additionality_and_accounting_note: Need contracts and technical work packages; design review and system development may qualify, while service purchase and routine operation do not.

status_or_evidence_as_of: 3 projects; EUR 83.187m recorded in ReGiS table as projects concluded/paid category; full project list needed

beneficiary_or_project: Invitalia Facility; strategic supply-chain projects including semiconductors

R&D_relevance: Low/mixed; only project R&D components
additionality_and_accounting_note: Measure includes development and production investments, not all R&D. The report explicitly merges predecessor lines; retain lineage in CID history and do not sum pre-revision allocations again.
